units: <cite ref="Pesachim 75a:4">Pes. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>אין זה צְלִי אש</he> this is not called ‘roasted by fire’ (<cite ref="Exodus 12:9">Ex. XII, 9</cite>); Y. ib. VII, 34ᵃ bot. <he>צ׳ אש ולא צ׳ שפוד וכ׳</he> (the text says.) ‘roasted by fire’, but not roasted through the heat of the spit, of the pot &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:4">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ובישולא … צ׳ קדר</he> and the last dish they offered me, they called ‘roast of the pot.’
